variants.title: B · Grouped variants (one level)
variants.description: A main screen is one row; its variants fold underneath as a flat group with a count badge split by kind (state = grey icon, overlay = blue icon). Filtering searches all 197 screens but pulls a matching variant's main screen in as a dimmed context row, so nothing is orphaned. A "Group variants" toggle falls back to today's flat list (each variant row then carries an "overlay of family-l2" sub-caption). Easier: overview (197 rows become 46), two badge kinds are readable at a glance. Harder: sequence steps (sheet-leave-confirm) appear as flat siblings of sheet-leave, the hierarchy between them is lost; a main with 37 variants (calendar-month) is a long flat group. Flow/Board: rows stay individually addressable and keep their own flow indicators; only the list presentation changes.

variants.title: C · Nested tree (arbitrary depth)
variants.description: The screen list becomes a tree with disclosure triangles and depth guides. A variant may itself have variants, so all three relations fit: state (two-parents › two-parents-solo), overlay (family-l2 › sheet-leave) and sequence step (sheet-leave › leave-confirm / leave-dissolve / leave-no-transfer), the latter marked with an arrow glyph. Collapsed nodes show the total subtree count. Filtering keeps the full ancestor path of a match as dimmed context rows and auto-expands only that path; unrelated siblings stay folded ("2 siblings hidden"). Easier: the hierarchy of a flow (family-l2 › leave › confirm) is visible in the list itself, sequences no longer flatten. Harder: 280px is narrow, so names below depth 1 are shown as an ellipsis-prefixed suffix (full name on hover); reparenting and the risk of over-nesting need rules. Flow/Board: every node is a normal screen with its own flow indicators; the tree is only the list presentation of a stored variant-of pointer.

variants.title: C · Tree with tags (chosen direction)
variants.description: Concept C tree, unlimited depth, with tag chips on every row. A row shows its first two tags plus a "+N" chip; hovering the chip lists all tags, hovering a truncated name ("...leave-no-transfer") shows the full name plus its path. A "Tags" toggle next to the search hides all chips (per-browser preference) and returns the tree to compact single-line rows. Depth 4 (leave-no-transfer > ...-error) still reads at 280px because only the suffix is shown and indentation stays 14px per level. Filtering by a tag (chr-379) highlights matching rows and their matching chip, keeps ancestors as grey context rows and folds non-matching siblings into a "N hidden" line. Trade-off: chips double the row height (12 rows instead of ~20 visible), which the toggle is for; tags on state/step variants repeat their parent's tags, so an inherit-tags-from-parent option may be worth considering. Flow/Board are unaffected: this is list presentation only.

title: Screen variants — sidebar list
description: How related screens (state / overlay / step variants) are grouped in the left screen list. B = one-level group with kind badges, C = nested tree. Includes filter behaviour when a variant matches but its main screen does not.
